submitted.rationale: All five EQE measurements came out near zero (|EQE| < 0.004%). Index 0 (Sb 0.211) had the only positive value, 0.00025%. It is Cu-rich: XRD of the similar index 1 shows CuSb2O6-like peaks plus an unidentified large-cell Cu-rich phase, and CuO-type phases can absorb at 2.1 eV. The Sb-rich end matches Sb2O4, which has a wide band gap and should not absorb at 2.1 eV. Every measured value is within noise of zero, so the whole line appears inactive under these conditions.
